what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5133 Iraqi refugees in Italy, 1.9% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1982 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1980 to 1988.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory from 1975 to 1992 and in 1995 and 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 98 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 6994, at the end of 2019.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
